page.overview:
Who is Manmayer Gurou?

Saint Manmayer Gurou is a World Noble from the Manmayer Family and a member of the Knights of God 62 years ago. He is the biological father of Manmayer Gunko from an unclear relationship with Esperia Kingdom's Queen Candelle during his stay there 77 years ago.

Gurou is a large man with a flat nose, pronounced lips, visible eyelashes, long hair, and a flat jaw. Much like his daughter, he has a rare form of , called Bipolar Irises. He wears a decorated greatcoat over his shoulders, which is lined with fur, a similarly decorated , a scarf, and striped socks. In addition, he wears a cap with goggles affixed around the band.

Like all World Nobles, and similar to other Knights of God, Gurou appears to be a man of low moral character. The nature of his relationship with Candelle is unknown, but considering her devotion to Reuven, it's heavily implied that it was not consensual. Likewise, he did not care for the resulting offspring, being his daughter Shuri, and was only willing to retrieve her at the request of Imu.

Being a World Noble of the Manmayer family, Gurou is above the law of the lower world and is permitted to do anything he pleases, so long as it does not go against the laws of the Celestial Dragons. He has tremendous political influence and can summon a Marine Admiral to handle anyone he feels is trying to bring harm to himself. However, being one of the Knights of God, he likely possesses more than sufficient combat prowess to defend himself without the needs of an Admiral.
